title: 'The Label,' the New Series Starring Christian De Sica and Claudio Santamaria Coming Soon to Netflix
summary: The cast also includes Cristiana Capotondi, Ornella Muti, Sofia Conti, Madior Giorgio Fall and Martina Gatti.
body_markdown:
#


THE LABEL


####


the new series starring


##


CHRISTIAN DE SICA and CLAUDIO SANTAMARIA


####


COMING SOON ONLY ON NETFLIX


#####


[FIRST LOOK](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/1493a282-eb4f-4853-b55e-05cb2624f206)


######


Credits: Sara Sabatino/Netflix


November 6, 2026


-


The Label


is the new six-episode Netflix series about the Italian music industry, starring


Christian De Sica


and


Claudio Santamaria.


Directed by


Luca Miniero


and produced by


Be Water Film


, the series will


soon be available only on Netflix


.


The cast also includes


Cristiana Capotondi


,


Ornella Muti


,


Sofia Conti


,


Madior Giorgio Fall


and


Martina Gatti


.


Label, Italy’s last major independent record label, is facing the most turbulent year in its history, drawing three generations of one family into the turmoil: Ade (Christian De Sica) is a brilliant, overbearing patriarch who refuses to step aside; his son Carlo (Claudio Santamaria) is under pressure from the banks and struggling with the weight of the family legacy; his granddaughter Celeste (Sofia Conti) brings a new wave of artists into the business. As the label nears bankruptcy and old and new collide, everyone is searching for the song — or the artist — that could save it. Meanwhile, love affairs and creative partnerships take shape and fall apart amid the daily chaos of the music industry.
